subject: Changing the UI related to the panel size in mirtCAT

messages.author: cd0ebcb57b88c479
messages.subject: Changing the UI related to the panel size in mirtCAT
parts:
Hi Phil and group,

This might not be a main interest of the mirtCAT package but I wonder whether there is an intuitive way to customize the resolution of the panel when deploying the assessment using mirtCAT() or createShinyGUI() function.

The motivating example can be found here: https://jzl95.shinyapps.io/IntroStatAssessment/

We have been struggling with having the app use the full area of the webpage so that a user doesn't need to scroll down to view the remaining parts of an item.

I'm pretty new to HTML and how the mirtCAT converts the settings specified in R into the HTML format.

Any helps or ideas would be appreciated.

Thanks!

-Jungmin
